considerAbandonedAfterMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity after which a search is considered abandoned.

searchTypesInPrioritizedOrder.description: Search types in configured priority order: Product, ProductCategory, or Content.

suppressOnEntityFromSearchResultViewed.description: Whether viewing an entity from the search results suppresses the Trigger.

searchTermConditionJson.description: JSON-encoded Relewise search-term condition, including nested AND/OR conditions. Parse this string as JSON and preserve any $type metadata. Null when not configured. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/triggers/.
